**How to Link PAN with Aadhaar | Step-by-Step Guide | Easy Process Explained**

In this video, we will walk you through the simple and quick steps to link your PAN (Permanent Account Number) with Aadhaar. Linking PAN and Aadhaar is mandatory for filing income tax returns and various other financial transactions in India. 

🔑 **Why Link PAN with Aadhaar?**
- Mandatory for filing income tax returns
- Prevents misuse of PAN
- Simplifies your financial transactions
- Helps in better tax compliance

📲 **Steps to Link PAN with Aadhaar**:
1. Visit the official Income Tax e-filing website: [incometaxindiaefiling.gov.in](https://incometaxindiaefiling.gov.in)
2. Login to your account or register if you haven’t already.
3. Navigate to the “Link Aadhaar” option.
4. Enter your PAN, Aadhaar number, and name as per Aadhaar.
5. Enter the captcha code and click on “Link Aadhaar”.
6. You will receive a confirmation message once the process is complete.

Alternatively, you can also link your PAN with Aadhaar via SMS or through the UIDAI portal.

**Make sure your details (name, date of birth, gender) match exactly in both your PAN and Aadhaar records.**

**Common Issues:**
- Mismatch in personal details.
- Invalid Aadhaar or PAN number.
- Server issues on the official portal.
